Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
  |    |-- [1a] Modify MappingPage overview
  |    |    |-- Replace obsolete injected DiagramService/controller ownership with the target's revision operations and session-owned controller; retain CanvasHistoryService as checkpoint owner.
  |    |    |-- Show MappingPage owning the editor canvas, workspace tools, explorer, SourceWindowPanel and their callers. The editor projects session state; SidePanels belong to diagram alternatives, not the FloatingBox union.
  |    |    `-- M3 destination: SourceWindowPanel renders retained source-code and code-panel projections outside the canvas; SourcePaneViewState retains pane navigation, scroll and camera state.
  |    |-- [1b] Extend MappingPage overview
  |    |    |-- Attach scoped authoring to MappingPage's PromptComposer and coordinator: per-prompt drafts, pinned references, templates, request progress and variant review; controller operations retain presentation choices and attached SidePanels without rebinding content.
  |    |    |-- Attach CanvasViewControls and CanvasViewDiffPreview to the active session controller: named checkpoints, working copies, branching and preview; the explorer calls these controls.
  |    |    |-- Attach DiagramSearchPanel and DiagramSearchService to workspace tools: worker-indexed current diagram content, match highlighting and version-checked reveal across saved, draft and proposal canvases.
  |    |    |-- Attach CanvasTreemapContent and ChangeTreemapContent to the Treemaps tool tab: derived source coverage or captured-change views, diagram tinting and navigation; neither owns canvas content.
  |    |    |-- Attach focused child-canvas projection to MappingPage's projectDiagrams action: selection or highlights call a workspace worker; the new child owns projectionLayout and checkpoint history, while parentCanvasId links it to its source.
  |    |    `-- Show agent bridge commands, revision/batch receivers and Agent Chat as callers of the session controller; autosave persists session and retained pane state, while explicit checkpoint publication saves catalog revisions.
  |    |-- [1a] Modify [C] FloatingBox variants
  |    |    `-- M3 source: remove source/code rendering from the ProjectedPane explanation. Retain its logical source-code and code-panel records and projection visibility; rendering is called by SourceWindowPanel in MappingPage, not by a new FloatingBox kind.
  |    |-- [2] Add N4: Scoped authoring and alternative presentation
  |    |    `-- Attach to the explicit PromptComposer/coordinator component in MappingPage; cover scoped requests, variant review, placement choices and SidePanel controls. Sources: MappingPage.tsx; prompt-composer/{PromptComposer,VariantReview,promptComposerCoordinator}.tsx/ts; domain/mapping/agent/diagramEdit.ts; domain/mapping/workspace/diagramAlternatives.ts.
  |    |-- [2] Add N6: Diagram search and match reveal
  |    |    `-- Attach to MappingPage's DiagramSearchPanel/DiagramSearchService component; cover worker indexing, current-content scope, matches, folding reveal and mapped-source navigation. Sources: MappingPage.tsx; search/{DiagramSearchPanel,diagramSearchService,diagramSearch.worker,revealSearchMatches}.tsx/ts; domain/mapping/search/diagramSearch.ts; source-pane/{SourceWindowPanel,SourceCodePane}.tsx.
  |    |-- [2] Add N7: Canvas and change treemaps
  |    |    `-- Attach to MappingPage's Treemaps tool-tab component; cover source-range coverage, captured-hunk allocation, tints and navigation. Sources: domain/mapping/treemap/canvasTreemap.ts; domain/mapping/changes/changeTreemap.ts; treemap/{CanvasTreemapContent,useTreemapRegionSelection}.tsx/ts; changes/{ChangeTreemapContent,treemapLayout}.tsx/ts.
  |    `-- [2] Add N8: Focused child canvases and layout
  |         `-- Attach to MappingPage's projectDiagrams action and its ProjectionLayoutPanel; cover selection/highlight inputs, independent child history, retained source and worker-calculated layout. Sources: MappingPage.tsx; domain/core/diagrams/highlightProjection.ts; workspace/{ProjectionLayoutPanel,workspaceTask,runWorkspaceTask}.tsx/ts; domain/core/diagrams/canvasTransfer.ts.
